text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan tell Yaeno Muteki about their injuries. It's still uncertain when—or if—they'll be able to return to the turf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're worried that no one will be waiting for them when they return, so Yaeno Muteki promises that she'll continue racing to keep their names in the public mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki and I head to Nakayama Racecourse to watch the Arima Kinen. Following her victory, the audience proclaims Oguri Cap the star of the generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It fills Yaeno Muteki with rage that no one mentions her or her friends. She cries that she and the others who battled for the Classic Triple Crown are the real stars of the generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She swears to defeat Oguri Cap and prove that she and her friends are the ones leading this generation. She now has the piece that she has been missing—an obsession.
